desc: Sighttron’s S-TAC Riflescope series delivers extreme accuracy at extreme ranges. These optics are available in multiple magnifications and a wide range of reticle options from simple crosshairs to complex bullet-drop compensation options, as well as with capped and exposed tactical style turrets. All models in the S-TAC family are equipped with Sighttron’s ExacTrack W&E System that provides proper alignment between the adjustments and the erector tube by maintaining the same constant and accurate point of pressure at zero or extreme adjustments, resulting in zero drift. The large oversized tactical knobs are easy to adjust in any weather conditions and are resettable to zero. The new internal zero-stop mechanism provides a tactile and audible positive stop for dead-on zero setting.
